versions.content: The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_NotifyTxConfirmation Ser- vices from the Rte_LdComCbkTxConfirmation callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references an LdComIPdu which has its LdComIP- duDirection parameter set to LDCOM_SEND [SWS_LDCOM_00054] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].

The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_NotifyTxConfirmation Ser- vices from the Rte_LdComCbkTxConfirmation callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references an LdComIPdu which has its LdComIP- duDirection parameter set to LDCOM_SEND [SWS_LDCOM_00054] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].

Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTxConfirmation_<CGI> Services from the Rte_COMCbkTxConfirmation callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references a ComIPdu which has its ComIPduDirec- tion parameter set to COM_SEND [SWS_COM_00916] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].
